title: 仕切り付き公園ベンチ
description: 公園や駅前広場に置く、仕切り付きの3人掛けベンチです。木製の座面と背もたれの板、黒い鋼製の脚と座受け、座席の間の曲げパイプの仕切り2本と両端の肘掛け、コンクリートの基礎ブロックを造形しています。銘板・寄贈表示などの文字、固定アンカーの地中部分は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.900 × 0.781 × 0.513 m、4,784三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A three-seat park bench with seat dividers for parks and station plazas. It models wooden seat and back slats, graphite steel legs and seat bearers, two bent-tube dividers between seats and end armrests, and precast concrete foot blocks. Plaques, dedication text and buried anchors are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.900 × 0.781 × 0.513 m; 4,784 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
